operations.summary: Create a project asset through the same transaction as the Project panel.
side_effects: Creates and imports a project asset with Undo support.

operations.summary: List asset kinds accepted by the project creation service.
Delete project assets addressed by GUID through asset history.
side_effects: Deletes asset files and metadata with Undo support.

operations.summary: Inspect one project asset addressed by GUID.
List project assets with stable GUID identities.
Save the current mesh geometry as an independent static asset with Undo/Redo.
side_effects: Creates and imports a new .inxmesh asset; never overwrites an existing path.

operations.summary: Read the imported source hierarchy, material slots and animation inventory of a model.
Extract a current imported material slot to an independent .mat asset; does not remap the model.
side_effects: Creates and imports a new .mat asset; never overwrites an existing path.

operations.summary: Move or rename one GUID-addressed asset inside the project.
side_effects: Moves an asset while preserving its GUID and records Undo.

operations.summary: Refresh the authoritative AssetDatabase catalog.
side_effects: Scans project asset roots and imports changed assets.

operations.summary: Read one UTF-8 project text asset addressed by GUID.
Replace one UTF-8 project text asset through Project history.
side_effects: Replaces and reimports a text asset with Undo support.

operations.summary: Focus the editor camera on a world-space point.
side_effects: Moves the editor Scene-view camera.

operations.summary: Read the editor Scene-view camera state.
Restore the complete editor Scene-view camera state.
side_effects: Moves the editor Scene-view camera.

operations.summary: Read the effective game Camera component document.
Cancel an unfinished engine render-target capture.
side_effects: Cancels a pending GPU readback request.

operations.summary: Request an asynchronous Scene, Game, complete Editor, or Camera target_texture PNG for human review.
side_effects: Queues GPU readback and writes a session review artifact.

operations.summary: Request an asynchronous GPU object-ID pick from the Scene target.
side_effects: Queues one GPU object-ID readback without changing selection.

operations.summary: Poll one Scene GPU object-ID pick.
Poll an engine render-target capture without returning pixels.
Read a bounded Editor Console snapshot with status-bar data separated.
Read one DataAsset's canonical document by asset GUID.
Set an existing DataAsset field through the engine document transaction.
side_effects: Changes and durably saves a DataAsset through editor history.

operations.summary: Describe one DataAsset's authoritative serialized fields by asset GUID.
Read one concise Infernux MCP guide by ID.
Search concise Infernux MCP guides and registered operation schemas.
Queue one keyboard transition through the engine event path.
side_effects: Injects one trusted SDL keyboard event into the Editor.

operations.summary: Press a key chord in order and release it in reverse order.
side_effects: Injects ordered SDL keyboard transitions into the Editor.

operations.summary: Hold one key through the engine input queue for an explicit duration.
side_effects: Queues a key-down transition, preserves it for the requested engine time window, then queues key-up.

operations.summary: Queue one editor pointer-button transition.
side_effects: Injects one SDL pointer-button event into the Editor.

operations.summary: Move, press, and release the editor pointer at one window coordinate.
side_effects: Injects pointer move, press, and release transitions into the Editor.

operations.summary: Move the editor pointer in window coordinates.
side_effects: Injects one SDL pointer-motion event into the Editor.

operations.summary: Queue one editor pointer-wheel event.
side_effects: Injects one SDL wheel event into the Editor.

operations.summary: Read synthetic editor-input queue delivery status.
Send UTF-8 text to the Editor's logical input target.
side_effects: Injects UTF-8 text into the Editor's logical focus target.

operations.summary: Wait until one queued synthetic-input sequence reaches the Editor.
Request Editor window close through the normal input path.
side_effects: Requests the Editor's normal close lifecycle.

operations.summary: Read one material's canonical document by asset GUID.
Set an existing value in a material document using a JSON pointer.
side_effects: Changes and durably saves a material through editor history.

operations.summary: Assign a GUID-addressed material to a renderer slot.
side_effects: Changes a renderer material slot and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Start a checkpoint-bound validation attempt and trace.
side_effects: Starts a validation trace for the active project.

operations.summary: Stop and save the active validation attempt trace.
side_effects: Writes the active trace into the session artifact directory.

operations.summary: Persist a trace-backed validation blocker report.
side_effects: Writes a blocker report into the session artifact directory.

operations.summary: List payload-verified Supervisor checkpoints for this session.
Verify one Supervisor checkpoint against the current project ledger.
Request normal Editor shutdown using the private Supervisor lease.
side_effects: Requests the Editor's normal close lifecycle.

operations.summary: Replace a Particle Graph with a complete strict schema document.
side_effects: Compiles and durably replaces a Particle Graph asset with Undo support.

operations.summary: Read a strict Particle Graph document addressed by asset GUID.
Set an existing Particle Graph document value and AOT-validate the result.
side_effects: Compiles and durably saves a Particle Graph asset with Undo support.

operations.summary: Build one registered Player target through the shared build service.
side_effects: Writes a standalone Player package and optionally Build Settings.

operations.summary: List Player targets contributed by core and enabled platform plugins.
Capture the managed Player Game render target for human review.
side_effects: Writes one Player render-target capture artifact.

operations.summary: Send one keyboard transition to the managed Player.
side_effects: Injects one SDL keyboard event into the managed Player.

operations.summary: Press and release one Player key with engine-controlled timing.
side_effects: Injects a timed SDL key press into the managed Player.

operations.summary: Launch the configured Debug Player under Supervisor control.
side_effects: Starts a managed standalone Player process.

operations.summary: Read bounded managed Player runtime and stdout log tails.
Arm bounded Player-owned motion sampling for public runtime objects.
side_effects: Arms a bounded observation job inside the managed Player.

operations.summary: Cancel one managed Player motion-sampling job.
side_effects: Cancels a Player-owned observation job.

operations.summary: Read one managed Player motion-sampling job.
Observe bounded public state from the managed Player.
Send one pointer-button transition to the managed Player.
side_effects: Injects one SDL pointer-button event into the managed Player.

operations.summary: Request normal managed Player shutdown without force termination.
side_effects: Requests normal shutdown of the managed Player.

operations.summary: Read managed Player process and readiness state.
Read the project, scene document state, and last scene-load outcome. After scene.open/reload is scheduled, check active_scene.last_load until loaded or failed; failures include the parser diagnostic.
Clear one renderer material slot's parameter override layer.
side_effects: Clears a renderer-local material parameter override layer.

operations.summary: Read one effective per-renderer material parameter override.
Remove one renderer-local material parameter override.
side_effects: Removes a renderer-local material parameter override.

operations.summary: Set one reflected material parameter on a renderer without mutating its shared material.
side_effects: Publishes a renderer-local material parameter override.

operations.summary: Explicitly enable or disable native GPU submission timestamps; changing query resources waits for in-flight compute.
side_effects: May wait for in-flight compute while changing native timestamp resources.

operations.summary: Return the current compute counters and reset their accumulation; does not submit pending work or change Play state.
side_effects: Resets cumulative compute counters, not GPU timestamp history.

operations.summary: Read cumulative compute transfers, submissions and CPU waits. GPU time is the latest completed submission, not a frame total.
Read the last Gizmo callback, geometry, packing, upload, and batch observation.
Pause the active Play Mode world.
side_effects: Pauses Play Mode simulation.

operations.summary: Reset and begin the bounded native frame timing window; does not change Play state.
side_effects: Resets previously collected frame timing samples.

operations.summary: Read native frame timing percentiles without GPU readback or resetting the window.
Enter Play Mode through the editor state machine.
side_effects: Replaces the edit world with a Play Mode world.

operations.summary: Resume a paused Play Mode world.
side_effects: Resumes Play Mode simulation.

operations.summary: Read Play Mode state, timing, pause state, and time scale.
Advance one frame while Play Mode is paused.
side_effects: Advances the paused simulation by one frame.

operations.summary: Exit Play Mode through the editor state machine.
side_effects: Stops Play Mode and restores the edit world.

operations.summary: Set Play Mode time scale.
side_effects: Changes the simulation time scale.

operations.summary: Make one loaded Scene and its authoring document active.
side_effects: Changes the active authoring Scene and document.

operations.summary: Load a scene asset additively into the current editor World.
side_effects: Adds one resident Scene without replacing existing Scenes.

operations.summary: Attach a registered native or Python component to a GameObject.
side_effects: Attaches a component and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Set one serialized component field through the shared component service.
side_effects: Changes a component field and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Remove one component through component history.
side_effects: Removes a component and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Describe the authoritative writable fields of one component.
Read the active scene hierarchy and serialized component state; inline mesh arrays are summarized by default.
List every Scene currently resident in the editor World.
Assign a registered Mesh asset, including mesh source state, through component history.
side_effects: Changes the renderer mesh source and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Instantiate one imported model asset through the same hierarchy transaction as a Project-panel drop.
side_effects: Instantiates a model hierarchy and records one Undo entry.

operations.summary: Create one GameObject through hierarchy history.
side_effects: Creates a scene object and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Delete explicit GameObjects through one hierarchy transaction.
side_effects: Deletes scene objects and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: List object kinds accepted by the editor's hierarchy creation service.
Move GameObjects under a parent or to the scene root.
side_effects: Changes the hierarchy and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Set one supported GameObject property through serialized-property history.
side_effects: Changes a GameObject property and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Set the complete local transform of one GameObject.
side_effects: Changes a Transform and records an Undo entry.

operations.summary: Schedule a scene asset load by GUID. The returned scheduled flag confirms that loading was queued.
side_effects: Replaces the active scene document.

operations.summary: Reload the active scene from disk, optionally discarding unsaved edits.
side_effects: Replaces the active scene with its persisted document.

operations.summary: Save the active scene through its registered document controller.
side_effects: Durably writes the active scene asset.

operations.summary: Enable or disable semantic Editor UI capture.
side_effects: Changes semantic capture state for subsequent Editor frames.

operations.summary: Request and read one semantic snapshot of rendered Editor controls.
Read semantic-capture sequencing without scheduling a frame.
Wait for a matching control to appear in a freshly rendered semantic frame.
